senses.nuances: 本项是专名识别说明，不是 DBP 官方释义。资料可确认英国音乐人 Tim Bricheno，但缺少原始语料，不能断定输入必然指他，也不能据此赋予普通词义。下列为专名用例和说明性短语，不宣称是高频词汇搭配。姓氏依据：[Ancestry：Bricheno](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/bricheno)；人名依据：[OCLC：Tim Bricheno](https://entities.oclc.org/worldcat/entity/E39PBJkMP6dpPbpxYVmCfqhvHC.html)。

etymology.historical_story: Bricheno illustrates how personal names can enter a word list without becoming ordinary vocabulary. The surname is documented, and Tim Bricheno is identified in an authority record as a British musician. Those facts establish a name, not a Malay meaning. The supplied packet provides no evidence for the surname's ultimate origin or the intended referent.
